text_sections.text: DigiXros -3: [Agunimon]×[BurningGreymon] When you would play this card, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each placed card reduces the play cost.

qa: No, it means for every 10 cards in the total sum of cards in your trash and the cards in your opponent's trash. For example, if you have 12 cards in your trash and your opponent has 8 cards in their trash, the total would be 20. Therefore, you trash 2 cards from your opponent's security stack.

text_sections.text: ＜Overflow (-5)＞ (As this card moves from the battle area or under a card to another area, lose 5 memory.)

When a Digimon is deleted and an [On Deletion] effect on a digivolution card is triggered, it will only be pending activation for the Digimon card with that digivolution card. If a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves that area before the effect activates, the effect can no longer be activated. In this case, if BT20-068 [Bakemon] is deleted and an [On Deletion] effect on a digivolution card is triggered, the effect will only be pending activation for BT20-068 [Bakemon]. If a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves that area before the effect activates, the effect can no longer be activated. In this case, if this card and the linked Digimon are deleted and an [On Deletion] link effect is triggered, the effect will only be pending activation for the linked Digimon card. If the deleted Digimon card with the effect that's pending activation leaves the trash, the [On Deletion] link effect that was pending activation can no longer be activated. Related Cards

qa: No, you can't activate it. If a Digimon is deleted and an [On Deletion] link effect is triggered, it will only be pending activation for the Digimon card with that link card. If a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves that area before the effect activates, the effect can no longer be activated. In this case, if this card and the linked Digimon are deleted and an [On Deletion] link effect is triggered, the effect will only be pending activation for the linked Digimon card. If the deleted Digimon card with the effect that's pending activation leaves the trash, the [On Deletion] link effect that was pending activation can no longer be activated. Related Cards

When a Digimon is deleted and an [On Deletion] effect on a digivolution card is triggered, it will only be pending activation for the Digimon card with that digivolution card. If a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves that area before the effect activates, the effect can no longer be activated. In this case, if BT21-068 [Growlmon] is deleted and an [On Deletion] effect on a digivolution card is triggered, the effect will only be pending activation for BT21-068 [Growlmon]. If the deleted BT21-068 [Growlmon] leaves the trash, the inherited [On Deletion] effect that was pending activation can no longer be activated. Related Cards
